note: Query keys folded out of write-capable fingerprints on these endpoints: values that change on every request (tokens, counters, span and session ids) and values that identify the account, session or client build rather than the operation (key: Google web client key, at: XSRF token, authuser: account index). Reviewed by hand from `python3 harness/site/query_schema.py propose calendar` and the label sheet; keys that select the operation (act, view, queryId, componentId, action, …) are never listed. See harness/site/query_schema.py.
